pending.method: Practice easier cases before harder ones (curriculum).
Perturb candidate claims a little more widely (annealing-style search).
Sample more broadly when many agents contribute (swarm-style wide search).
Stop a perturbation run sooner when it stops paying (early stopping).
React sooner when expected progress does not arrive (error-driven stall detection).
Rotate away from the last-tried claim form more strongly (novelty over repetition).
Remember already-tried targets for longer before retrying them (longer working memory).
